surgeries.title: Surgeries
surgeries.lead: Every operation booked as a doctor's time: patient, procedure and hospital — and the date sent to the hospital.
surgeries.patient_help: Pick a patient from the clinic's files, or type the name and phone.
surgeries.add_hospitals_html: Add the hospitals you work with in Settings → Pharmacies & centres.
surgeries.empty_upcoming: No upcoming surgeries. Block the doctor's time and choose "Surgery".
surgeries.empty_all: No surgery has been booked yet.

status_saved.cancelled: The surgery is cancelled and the doctor's time freed.

surgeries.send_sub: Send the surgery date and the patient's details to the hospital from the clinic's e-mail or on WhatsApp.
surgeries.texts_help_html: Change the wording in Settings → Message texts.
surgeries.emailed: The surgery date was sent to {to}.
surgeries.cancel_confirm: Cancel the surgery? The doctor's time is freed in the calendar; the surgery stays in the list as cancelled.
surgeries.cancelled_note: The surgery is cancelled. To book it again, block the doctor's time and choose "Surgery".

err.NO_PHONE: Enter a valid WhatsApp number for the hospital.
err.NO_MAIL: The clinic's e-mail is not set up yet (Settings → E-mail).
err.MAIL_FAILED: The e-mail could not be sent. Try again.
err.SURGERY_NO_TIME: The surgery's time was freed; book it again from the calendar.
